name: Option N.V.
summary: Option NV engages in the cloudgate, radio communication, and lighting businesses in Belgium. The company offers outdoor LoRaWAN antenna 8 dBi; cloudgate gateways products; standard and industrial serial, smart metering, ethernet expansion, BLE expansion card, LoRaWAN, and WLAN Card; CloudGate probe LoRaWAN and cellular; and sensor products. It also provides LuvitRED Application, a cloudGate application for design and deployment of smart IoT solutions; SRAS Application which provides secure remote access from laptop/smartphone to cloudgate gateways and the devices attached to it; and CloudGate wizard application enables the creation of IoT applications. In addition, the company offers various solutions, including IT and networks, retail, transportation, smart building, smart city, smart energy, smart home, surveillance and security, and telematics. The company was formerly known as Crescent NV and change its name to Option NV in May 2018. Option NV was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Leuven, Belgium.
